title: Creative Strategy / Landing Pages Huddle
summary: October fell well short of plan (Oct 19 to 25: $190,000 spend against $560,000 planned, 1,200 new customers against 4,600, 0.65 first-order ROAS against 0.90), tied to too few net-new concepts and expensive CPMs. The goal is to lift spend from about $30,000 a day to $50,000 to $70,000 within weeks, then back to $100,000.
points: Priorities: unaware brain, prostate, kidney, blood pressure, plaque and cholesterol angles
Formats: drama, singing and conspiratorial-style ads
The broader brain landing page is about to publish on the existing URL
Jennifer Casper Caras joins Elissa's group
decisions: Lucas pauses AppLovin and focuses on Meta
No Cosmos study references; no exact flavanol amounts in future creative (existing 500 mg videos may still launch)

tasksImported.title: Produce unaware concepts for brain, prostate and neuro angles
Fix the AppLovin rejections on the blood-pressure ads
Pause AppLovin production and focus on Meta
Assign briefs to Jennifer Casper Caras
Publish the revised brain landing page
Remove Cosmos study references and exact flavanol amounts from new creative
